items.text: Jamshid Barzegar said Donald Trump's support for Benjamin Netanyahu indicates increased coordination between Washington and Tel Aviv to confront the Islamic Republic. He added that the likelihood of new military operations against the Islamic Republic has increased. There is also disagreement in Tehran over negotiation or continued confrontation with the US.

Reza Pahlavi urged American voters to consider candidates' positions on the Iranian people and freedom. He stated that a free Iran benefits both Iranians and the world and called the Islamic Republic the root of the crisis. He emphasized that the only sustainable solution is to remove the regime.

Abbas Kaabi, a member of the Assembly of Experts presidium, stated that revenge against Trump and Netanyahu is certain. He mentioned using the country's capacities and 32 million devoted lives as ways to counter the enemy's breach of commitments. These remarks were made in an interview with Tasnim.

Donald Trump expressed full and unconditional support for Benjamin Netanyahu in the Israeli prime ministerial election. Trump described the Islamic Republic of Iran as a serious threat and warned that if behavior does not change, they will finish the job soon. Netanyahu thanked Trump for his support and said they will complete the mission together.

Mokhtar Al-Boshokeh was transferred from solitary confinement to the general ward in Arak prison but continues his hunger strike and faces health issues. Hamzeh Savari Lofte has also started a hunger strike in support of him and is experiencing low blood pressure. Both political prisoners are held in Arak and Qezelhesar prisons.

An 800-year-old historic plane tree in the village of Zaglik, Ahar County, was cut down. The tree was registered as a national heritage site and was cut for selling wood and funding the construction of a restroom. A legal case has been filed and the loader used has been confiscated.

Workers at Damash mineral water factory reported non-payment of four months of their insurance premiums. Despite deductions from their salaries, insurance services have been cut off for about a month. This has caused difficulties for workers and their families in accessing medical treatment.

Hamidreza Haji Babaei, the deputy speaker of the parliament, spoke about American bombs and Iran's missile program. He said Iran has plans for all types of American bombs. He also stated that if the US brings 'mother bombs,' Iran will respond with 'father missiles.'
Thousands of Iranian trucks have stopped at the Pakistan border. The reason for the stoppage is not specified. This issue has caused transportation problems.

A Malavan fan said the cause of tension at Sirous Ghayeghran Stadium was a controversial move by Shoja Khalilzadeh during warm-up. Shoja repeated the same gesture as before, placing his hand on his groin. This caused the stadium atmosphere to become chaotic.

Mehdi Tartaar commented on Amirhossein Mahmoudi's benching, stating that the coaching staff decides who plays. He emphasized that Mahmoudi has been training well. Tartaar also highlighted the importance of compensating for lost points in upcoming matches.

The Gulf Cooperation Council condemned the attacks by the Houthis on Saudi Arabia and missile and drone attacks by the Islamic Republic and its proxy forces. The council expressed full solidarity with Saudi Arabia and affirmed the right to individual and collective defense. The statement emphasized that an attack on any member is an attack on all members.

Tariq Metri, Lebanon's Deputy Prime Minister, announced that the country has asked the Islamic Republic to appoint a new ambassador in Beirut. He also said the ban on Iranian planes landing in Beirut was to prevent an Israeli attack. No progress has been made regarding the monopoly of weapons by the Lebanese government.

Niusha Saremi mentioned Trump's unconditional support for Netanyahu in the audio version of Titrawal. This support coincided with an ultimatum to the Islamic Republic. The topic was discussed in the Titrawal program.
Egypt and the UAE have entered a regional war against Tehran's proxy forces. These developments indicate escalating tensions in the region. No further details are provided in the text.

Chris Wright, the US Energy Secretary, spoke with CNN about the Trump administration's policies toward Iran and the country's security situation. He mentioned that 30 to 40 thousand people were killed in Iran before the conflicts and commented on gasoline prices, expressing dissatisfaction but noting a positive trend in price reduction. Wright also explained that the suspension of sanctions related to Lindsey Graham's proposed law is not a cancellation of sanctions.

Donald Trump announced that he supports Benjamin Netanyahu because he has a good relationship with him. He said they will continue their successful cooperation if Netanyahu is re-elected. Trump also expressed doubt about cooperating with another leader in Israel.

Khodadad Azizi, head of the Tractor team, called for the football federation to take action against Malavan fans due to ethnic slogans that led to the cancellation of the match. He stated the match will be held in Tabriz and warned that if no action is taken, Tractor fans will handle it themselves. Azizi is banned from stadiums for four months due to insulting Omid Alishah.

Mehrdad Akhlaghi, the defense minister of the Islamic Republic, stated that the armed forces are ready for war with Israel. He mentioned that future weapons factories will be built in secure and suitable locations. These remarks indicate a focus on military preparedness.

The Israeli Prime Minister stated that Russia's cooperation with the Islamic Republic is against Israel's interests. He said Moscow operates networks of anti-Semitic bot accounts and has expressed Israel's protest to Russia. Netanyahu also warned about the danger of a nuclear Iran for Russia.

On October 17 and 18, two workers died in Gorgan and Rasht. Additionally, two workers were injured in Kangan and Tehran. The incidents involved a vehicle collision, falling from a building, a workshop fire, and a hand caught in an industrial meat grinder.

Mehdi Mahdavi-Azad said in the program "Cheshmandaz" that continuing Iran's nuclear policy increases the risk of a third world war. He noted that acquiring nuclear weapons does not necessarily prevent war or the collapse of governments. The nuclear program serves more as a tool for maintaining power than for national interests.

Benjamin Netanyahu announced Israel's new national security strategy emphasizing prevention and preemptive strikes. This strategy replaces the traditional threat containment policy. Netanyahu cited the wars following the October 7, 2023 attack as the reason for this change.
Erfan Karamvisi, a 19-year-old citizen from Badreh county, was arrested by the IRGC intelligence agents. The arrest took place yesterday. He was transferred to an unknown location.

At least seven protests were held today, Sunday, 26 Mehr, by Social Security retirees in Kermanshah, Shoosh, Rasht, Ahvaz, and Tehran, and steel retirees in Isfahan. Yesterday, Lamari car voucher holders also protested against delays in car delivery. In total, at least seven protests focused on livelihood, healthcare demands, and car delivery follow-ups were reported.
